what: The engine's own 2M memory (qwen3-1.7b). For each Long Haul question of four families, the chosen room and the 4 closest moments were read as plain words, with three instructions, greedy decoding, max 60 tokens. 256K rows use the same 2M memory with today's date at day 16; only the date differs.

wordings.longhaul: engram.bench.local.LONGHAUL_INTRO (the yardstick's wording; what the Long Haul runs used)
wordings.intro: engram.memory.INTRO (the engine's own wording, from the 2-3 Nov quiz)
wordings.soft: a softer wording written during the diagnosis; not used in any run, since it was written while looking at these questions

wake_test: wake-test-2M.json: the 40 recall questions at 2M, asleep rooms read as words against woken as notes: 2/40 both ways (facts 0/10 both ways)
room_chosen: at 2M the room holding the planted moment was chosen for 16 of 40 recall questions (6 of 10 facts); 37 of 40 hit an asleep room
